raise_justifications.backend/utils/apps.py: get_available_app_model_by_id: the set-preferred-app availability authority as a validated App model, so the summary path honors what the setter admitted instead of re-deciding with the installed slice (#10074).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/conversations/process_conv: extract_memories returns a ConversationMemoryExtractionResult emitted once as the Conversation Memories Extracted product-analytics event after durable persistence, closing the validated macOS recording-to-memory observability gap (SCA-99); canonical broad short-term intake now replaces legacy extraction at that persistence boundary, preserving one authoritative write path and its coupled deletion and source-generation semantics (FC-split-mutation-authority).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/memory/canonical_consolida: Candidate selection, bounded retry leases, and atomic promotion planning remain one canonical long-term admission authority; extracting them would permit competing admission state machines (FC-split-mutation-authority).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/memory/canonical_memory_ad: Canonical conversation replacement coordinates source-generation fencing, bounded lineage discovery, and atomic replacement application; splitting this state machine would duplicate lifecycle authority (FC-split-mutation-authority).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/other/storage.py: delete_app_logo now requires an exact app-logo bucket prefix (startswith) so a foreign URL embedding the prefix later cannot delete an unrelated object on this deletion path (David review on #9873).
raise_justifications.backend/utils/sync/pipeline.py: Speech-free segments are now recorded as valid silence beside the existing outcome recorders rather than as retryable failures (#10544), so a recording of pure noise stops finalizing the job failed and re-uploading forever; the helper and its billing guard are colocated with the segment-outcome recording they mirror.
